description: Set Stroke panel options on items: weight, type (stroke style), colour and tint, cap, join and miter limit, stroke alignment, start and end arrowheads with their scale and alignment, gap colour and tint, dash corner adjustment and custom dash/gap lengths (Window > Stroke). Weights and lengths are points

align.description: Align Stroke: centred on, inside or outside the path

arrowAlignment.description: Align arrowheads inside or outside the path end

cap.description: Cap: the shape of open path ends

color.description: Stroke colour: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

cornerAdjustment.description: Corners: how dashes and gaps adjust to meet at corners

dashAndGap.description: Dashed stroke: dash, gap, dash, gap... lengths in points (2, 4 or 6 values)

end.description: End: arrowhead at the end of an open path

gapColor.description: Gap Color of dashed, dotted and striped strokes: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

start.description: Start: arrowhead at the start of an open path

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

type.description: Stroke type: a stroke style name such as "Solid", "Dashed", "Dotted", "Thick - Thin" or a custom style

name: set_item_stroke
title: Set Item Stroke
